from_quote: the subject commenced in my last number, to wit, the necessity of an equal and full representation in the legislature
rationale: The paragraph refers to Brutus's "last number" and summarizes its argument on representation, the subject of Brutus III (November 15, 1787); this essay appeared November 29, 1787.

from_quote: I have stated this in my first number, as one of the reasons against going into so entire a consolidation of the States
rationale: The paragraph refers to Brutus's "first number", Brutus I (October 18, 1787), which argued against consolidating the States into one government.

from_quote: have therefore provided for calling out the militia to execute the laws of the Union
rationale: The paragraph names the Convention's provision "for calling out the militia to execute the laws of the Union", echoing the words of Article I, Section 8, clause 15.
to_quote: To provide for calling forth the Militia to execute the Laws of the Union

from_quote: By section four, article one, the Congress are authorized, at any time, by law, to make, or alter, regulations respecting the time, place and manner of holding elections for senators and representatives
rationale: The paragraph cites "section four, article one" and restates the words of its first clause on the times, places and manner of holding elections.
to_quote: the Congress may at any time by Law make or alter such Regulations

from_quote: under this article, the Federal legislature may institute such rules respecting elections
rationale: The paragraph continues the discussion of the elections clause cited in the previous paragraph, referring to it as "this article" and "the power of regulating elections".

from_quote: the dangers apprehended from this clause are merely imaginary, that the proposed general legislature will be disposed to regulate elections upon proper principles
rationale: The paragraph refers to "this clause", the elections clause discussed in the preceding paragraphs, and names the power of the general legislature "to regulate elections".
